state-layer-pressed-opacity.$description: Fluent 2 state layer: its amount while pressed (docs/adr/0004).

state-layer-focus-opacity.$description: Fluent 2 state layer: its amount on keyboard focus (docs/adr/0004).

shell-phone-below.$description: Narrow window (Platforms Standard 3.3): below this width the navigation is a bottom bar and the pane a screen of its own

shell-min-width.$description: AppShell minSize: below this width the shell shows the screen-size notice (docs/adr/0010).

shell-frame-width.$description: AppShell frame="centered": the frame's inline size; at a window this wide or narrower the frame fills the window (docs/adr/0023, #862).

shell-min-height.$description: AppShell minSize: below this height the shell shows the screen-size notice (docs/adr/0010).

safe-area-top.$description: The top safe area (a notch, the status bar): the header stays below it (Platforms Standard 3.5)

safe-area-bottom.$description: The bottom safe area (the home indicator, gesture navigation): the bottom bar and the footer stay above it

safe-area-start.$description: The left safe area (landscape with a notch)

safe-area-end.$description: The right safe area (landscape with a notch)

touch-long-press-delay.$description: How long a finger rests on a control before it counts as a long press (Android's long-press timeout is 400 to 500ms); a long press shows a tooltip on touch (Platforms Standard 6.5)

touch-dismiss-delay.$description: How long a tooltip opened by a long press stays after the finger lifts (Material 3 › Tooltips: 1.5s)

font-data-word-spacing.$description: Every Reddit Mono text (data, code, numbers): its word spacing, so a space is as wide as DM Sans's beside it (the text-data and text-code roles carry it; check-system rule text-contract).

before: /* ── SPACING ROLES: inline, stack, inset, cluster, region (fixed relationships) ── */

category-soft-border-amount.$description: The share of a soft category pill's border color kept in its border (the rest is the pill's soft fill); 100% keeps the border as is, for every hue but pink (ADR 0049).

space-stack-field.$description: The gap between read-only field tiles in a stacked list, at every density: 16px, the owner's preset (D-0106, ADR 0032; was 20px under ADR 0030).

space-stack-group.$description: The space above each group of read-only fields (its group heading), at every density (D-0106, ADR 0032).

space-section.$description: The space between peer sections (a heading and its content, then the next) that are not framed: twice a heading's distance to its content, the same in a page or a split pane, at every density, in either reading direction and on phones (owner, 2026-10-22, issue #242).

space-stack-2xl.$deprecated: Not used by any page, application or the design spec (issue 882): it keeps working, and is removed no earlier than the next minor release.

space-stack-3xl.$description: The space between the year groups of a grouped Timeline (80px; ADR 0036).

size-field-tile-min.$description: The narrowest read-only tile (PropertyList variant tiles): two tiles share a row from 496px, narrower lists show one per row (ADR 0044, #1043).

size-calendar-tile.$description: The calendar date tile of a grouped Timeline: its width and height (56px; ADR 0036).

size-calendar-tile-sm.$description: The calendar date tile of the compact grouped Timeline: its width and height (40px; ADR 0048).

size-calendar-band.$description: The calendar date tile: the height of its top band (20px; the month sits inside it).

size-calendar-band-sm.$description: The compact calendar date tile: the height of its top band (16px; ADR 0048).

content-max-list.$description: The readable maximum inline size of a list of lines, such as the compact grouped Timeline (760px; ADR 0048). Aligned to the inline start.

size-section-rule.$deprecated: The line under a year heading is no longer drawn (ADR 0048). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.
size-section-rule.$description: The soft line under a year heading: its length (72px).

size-watermark.$description: The watermark year of a grouped Timeline: the width of its column (24px).

space-cluster-lg.$deprecated: Not used by any page, application or the design spec (issue 882): it keeps working, and is removed no earlier than the next minor release.

label-height-16px.$deprecated: Renamed: use --plx-sys-label-height-sm (a name says its step, not its value; docs/adr/0002). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.

label-height-20px.$deprecated: Renamed: use --plx-sys-label-height-md (a name says its step, not its value; docs/adr/0002). It keeps working and is removed in 2.0.0.

before: /* ── LAYOUT: shell (the global header; the shell's other regions take their widths from the density) ── */
/* ── SIZES OF THINGS INSIDE A LAYOUT (batch 150): fields narrower than their column, and lists that scroll ── */

field-width-md.$description: a hex value, a short code

com.plenix.after: /* a hex value, a short code */

field-width-lg.$description: a name, a filter, a picker

com.plenix.after: /* a name, a filter, a picker */

scroll-max-sm.$description: a short list in a dialog

com.plenix.after: /* a short list in a dialog */

label-width-sm.$description: the label column of a narrow inline field (an inspector)

com.plenix.after: /* the label column of a narrow inline field (an inspector) */

boundary-outline-width.$description: The outline of a surface that floats on a shadow (menus, dialogs, cards): none, and a thin line in forced colors, where shadows are not drawn.

boundary-outline-color.$description: The color of the boundary outline: none, and the text color in forced colors.

plenix.purpose: The outline of a surface that floats on a shadow, drawn only in forced colors (CanvasText there).

forced-indicator.$description: An indicator's fill in forced colors (a progress fill): Highlight there; otherwise not set (initial), so the component keeps its own color.

forced-gap.$description: The gap in a ring in forced colors (the spinner's): Canvas there; otherwise not set (initial), so the component keeps its own.

overlay-editor-min-inline-size.$description: The smallest inline size of an editor that opens over its field, such as a DataGrid cell's long-text box: the field's width or this, whichever is larger (#84, docs/adr/0016).

print-hidden.$description: On paper the chrome is left out (the app header, the navigation pane, the skip link, the scrim, the floating action button, toasts, the spotlight): their display reads it. Not set on screen (initial: the element keeps its own).

undo-duration.$description: How long an undo stays offered before the action is final (DeleteFlow's undo toast; it pauses while hovered or focused). 10s; DeleteFlow undoDuration overrides it (#144, docs/adr/0017, D-0057).

icon-fill-scale.$description: How much larger than its area an icon is drawn when it must fill that area with no box (the drawn shape reaches the area's edges, centered; #418, D-0059).

print-sheet-inline-size.$description: PrintDocument: the sheet's width, on screen and paper (docs/adr/0014).

print-sheet-block-size.$description: PrintDocument: the sheet's minimum height on screen; it grows with its content (docs/adr/0014).

print-document-margin.$description: PrintDocument: the page margin on paper (@page plx-document) and the sheet's padding on screen (docs/adr/0014).

print-sheet-padding.$description: PrintDocument: the sheet's padding on screen; 0 on paper, where the page carries the margin (docs/adr/0014; #348).

print-sheet-border-width.$description: PrintDocument: the sheet's border on screen; 0 on paper (docs/adr/0014; #348).

print-sheet-radius.$description: PrintDocument: the sheet's corners on screen; square on paper (docs/adr/0014; #348).

print-sheet-shadow.$description: PrintDocument: the sheet's shadow on screen; none on paper (docs/adr/0014; #348).

print-break.$description: PageBreak: break-before; auto on screen, page on paper (the print set) (docs/adr/0014).

print-block-size.$description: On paper the shell is as tall as its content: the shell's fixed heights read it. Not set on screen.

print-max-block-size.$description: On paper nothing is cut to a maximum height: a region with a set height (a data grid's) reads it. Not set on screen.

print-overflow.$description: On paper nothing scrolls: the shell's scrolling regions read it. Not set on screen.

print-position.$description: On paper the shell's positioned regions take their place in the flow. Not set on screen.

print-shown.$description: On paper what Show print marks is shown: its box reads it. Not set on screen (initial: hidden).

print-keep.$description: On paper cards, notices and figures are not split across two sheets and headings stay with what follows them: their break-inside and break-after read it. Not set on screen (initial: auto).

print-url-before.$description: On paper inside plx-print-urls, the text before an external link's address. Not set on screen (initial: no address).

print-url-after.$description: On paper inside plx-print-urls, the text after an external link's address. Not set on screen.
